text:
jordan: Originating RC build: 2.1.0-rc3. Artifacts uploaded to CI: https://ci.redwood.ai/artifacts/2.1.0-rc3. Need QA + infra signoff for promo window 14:30-15:00 UTC. @maria @kevin @amy please ack.

deploy-bot: Build uploaded: image:redwood/app:2.1.0-rc3. Automated checks started (lint, unit, infra-smoke). CI job #5824.

maria: I'll run a quick staging smoke and a few prompt-level regression setups. ETA ~8m.

kevin: Quick note — pin DB migration to the safe version (v2.0.5) while we promote. Last RC had a migration drift.

kevin: Pin command (infra):
```
./release pin --service db --version v2.0.5 --env prod
```

amy: QA results so far: smoke tests green, no latency regressions on the sample prompt set. Logging looks clean. +1 from QA once I finish the rerun against the long tail prompts.

jordan: Plan: canary 10% for 30m, then 50% for 10m, then 100% if no SLO breaches. Rollback criteria: >5% 5xx or >15% token-latency degradation across p50/p95 for 30m. Rollback command: 
```
deploy-bot rollback --to image:redwood/app:2.1.0-rc2 --reason "regression-detected"
```

kevin: Also adding an automated traffic-fallback route to previous model variant and enforcing conservative batching for first 15m. I'll flip routing weights if needed.

maria: Tagging oncall: @oncall-sre — I'll stream traces to the ops dashboard during canary.

oncall-sre: Oncall here. I'll monitor service errors and latencies. If I see >3% errors I will escalate and trigger rollback per runbook: https://playbooks.redwood.ai/release-rollback.

jordan: Approvals checklist: QA: @maria, Infra: @kevin, PM: @amy. Need all +1s by 14:10 UTC to meet the 14:30 promo.

kevin: Pinning artifact now: `./ci/pin-artifact 2.1.0-rc3` — pinned to release-bucket/prod/2.1.0-rc3.

deploy-bot: Promotion scheduled at 14:35 UTC. Canary plan: 10% -> 50% -> 100% over 45m. Auto-rollback enabled on SLO breach.

maria: Adding targeted regression test set "latency-regressions" to post-promo checks and kicking off run.

amy: Drafted release notes (will post in #announcements before promo):
- Deploy: 2.1.0-rc3
- Feature: faster KV cache warmup for long chats
- Perf: ~8% p95 token latency improvement on embeddings workloads
- Ops: DB migration pinned to v2.0.5; no schema changes required

jordan: All green from my side. No outstanding blockers. Proceeding to promote at scheduled time unless objections. :rocket: :thumbsup:

kevin: No objections. I'll keep infra throttles conservative for first 15m.

oncall-sre: Monitoring hooks added (error-rate, token-latency p50/p95, queue depth). Alerts will page if thresholds exceeded.

maria: QA final: +1 — long-tail prompts clean.

amy: PM: +1, notes posted to #announcements.

jordan: Promo in progress.

deploy-bot: Promotion started at 14:35 UTC. Canary rollout: 10% traffic -> scheduled step to 50% in 30m. Link: https://ops.redwood.ai/deploy/2.1.0-rc3

maria: Watching traces. No regressions at 10% after 12m.

kevin: infra metrics stable. increasing to 50% now.

deploy-bot: Canary moved to 50% at 15:05 UTC. Continuing monitoring.

oncall-sre: No alerts yet. p95 down slightly which is expected.

jordan: If everything stays ok we'll finish promotion to 100% in 10m.

deploy-bot: Promotion to 100% completed at 15:18 UTC. All done. Release artifact: image:redwood/app:2.1.0-rc3.

amy: Logging the release notes + postmortem template for next-week checkin.

maria: Running final sanity tests in prod, looks stable.

kevin: Unpinning temporary infra throttles. Leaving DB pin in place for rollback safety.

jordan: Thanks everyone. Will follow up with a short retrospective tomorrow. :party_popper:
